_note: --stateless workers. command 'claude-stateless' is: claude -p --tools "" --system-prompt-file PREFIX --json-schema SCHEMA --setting-sources "" --strict-mcp-config --output-format stream-json --verbose --model MODEL (not --bare, which needs an API key). Log in first with `claude` (subscription) once on the PC. Placeholders: {model} {prefix_file} {schema}. Every call is one request with no tools; the answer comes back through --json-schema. item_usd is checked after the call against the list price. The optional producer_agent role runs orders whose prompt exceeds 150k tokens on the agent route.
